changeSet.author: tournament-types
changeSet.comment: Add tournament_casual to free plans' allowed_event_types. Since tournament_casual is unranked (like open_casual), free plans can use it. Paid/verified plans already allow all types (NULL) so they inherit these automatically.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE subscription_plans SET allowed_event_types = allowed_event_types || '["tournament_casual"]'::jsonb WHERE is_default_free = true AND allowed_event_types IS NOT NULL AND NOT (allowed_event_types ? 'tournament_casual');

rollback.sql: UPDATE subscription_plans SET allowed_event_types = allowed_event_types - 'tournament_casual' WHERE is_default_free = true AND allowed_event_types ? 'tournament_casual';

changeSet.author: tournament-types
changeSet.comment: Update column comment to reflect new tournament types.
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN subscription_plans.allowed_event_types IS 'Event types this plan can create. NULL = all types. Array of strings like ["open_casual", "open_ranked", "tournament", "tournament_casual", "tournament_club", "coaching"].';
